Improve PWA icon quality with scalable SVG icons and a 1024 px PNG fallback rendered directly from vector artwork.

- Add a dedicated maskable SVG with an opaque background for Android.
- Refresh the service-worker cache to include the updated manifest and new icons.
- Retain 192 px and 512 px PNG icons for platform compatibility.

After updating, reinstall the PWA on Android to refresh the installed splash icon. Splash appearance still needs verification on a physical device.

Docker images support Linux amd64 and arm64:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/abdusco/pisti:v1.0.1
```

Also tagged as `1.0.1` and `latest`.
